tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read one full Atisbo documentation page as markdown, by its site-relative URL (for example /docs/api/webhooks).

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List Atisbo documentation pages with their URL, title and description. Omit limit for the whole corpus; pass limit to cap the response.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Atisbo documentation by keyword or natural-language question. Returns ranked page titles, URLs, descriptions and match scores.
